question: As announced in the Union Budget of Financial Year 2022, income from virtual digital assets will be taxed at ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**30%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• On 1st February 2022, Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman presented the union budget.
 
• **Virtual Digital Assets are the digital representations of assets or any information that can be digitally traded or transferred.**
 
 
• It is also termed a code or number or token generated in digital form through cryptographic means.</li&
